content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Option one: Use a local mobile money API like M-Pesa. This works for domestic sales but fails for international buyers. Option two: Rely on Gumroad or similar platforms. These lock you into their payment processors, which reject Kenyan accounts. Option three: Build a sovereign stack using Cloudflare infrastructure and blockchain payments. This removes geographic barriers entirely. COREMERCH’s Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) upgrades to Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and automated delivery. Both options give you full ownership and bypass restricted platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Local payment gateways like M-Pesa are geographically confined. International platforms like Gumroad or Paddle exclude Kenya from their supported regions. Blockchain-based systems like NOWPayments operate without geographic restrictions. They process payments from any country, in any of 300+ cryptocurrencies. COREMERCH stacks integrate NOWPayments directly into your infrastructure. This means a buyer in the US can purchase your ebook using USDT on Tron, settling in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. The system does not care where you or your buyer are located.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

M-Pesa transactions are fast domestically but irrelevant internationally. Gumroad’s fees start at 8.5% plus $0.30 per transaction, assuming you could use it. Blockchain payments via NOWPayments charge 0.5% with no monthly fees. COREMERCH stacks optimize for low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON. A $10 ebook sale on TRON costs the buyer under $0.10 in fees and confirms in under a minute. Your cost is the one-time stack deployment fee. There are no recurring platform fees, no revenue shares, and no geographic penalties.
Blockchain payments remove geographic restrictions entirely—no country blocks, no platform locks.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

M-Pesa and Gumroad own your payment flow. They can suspend your account or change their terms. COREMERCH stacks give you full ownership of your infrastructure. Once deployed, the system runs on your GitHub or Cloudflare account. You control the backend logic, the order storage, and the file delivery. Automation is handled via Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. When a payment confirms on-chain, the system automatically delivers the ebook via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. You are not renting a platform—you are deploying your own.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you only sell domestically, M-Pesa might suffice. If you aim to sell internationally, blockchain-based systems are the only reliable option. COREMERCH’s Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is ideal for creators launching with 3 products. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) suits those needing advanced automation and email delivery. For full documentation and all templates, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes every blueprint and template COREMERCH offers. Choose based on your scale, not your location. The architecture removes geographic barriers by design.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Creators in Africa can sell digital products to international buyers using blockchain-based payment systems integrated with Cloudflare infrastructure. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, processes payments without geographic restrictions, and charges a flat 0.5% fee. COREMERCH stacks deploy this system on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, ensuring automatic delivery and full ownership. For example, a buyer in Europe can purchase your course using USDT on Tron, with the transaction settling in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. The system works identically for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and other restricted regions.
Cloudflare infrastructure ensures your stack runs without downtime, regardless of your location.

Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan face similar payment restrictions. Binance P2P supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees, making it a reliable on-ramp for buyers in these regions. COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates needed to deploy a sovereign commerce stack, available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Whether you’re selling ebooks in Lagos or templates in Dhaka, the architecture removes geographic barriers by design.
Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy your sovereign commerce stack with these steps: First, choose your stack—Sovereign Starter ($97) or Edge Commerce ($197). Second, provide your GitHub or Cloudflare account details for deployment. Third, select your preferred cryptocurrencies and networks (BSC, Solana, TRON recommended). Fourth, load your products into the system. Fifth, test end-to-end functionality. Sixth, configure your domain and email delivery if using the Edge Stack. Seventh, launch your store. Eighth, monitor payments via NOWPayments dashboard. Ninth, automate re-delivery requests via Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Tenth, scale by adding more products or upgrading your stack.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I sell to US buyers using this system?

Yes. The system processes payments from any country. A US buyer can purchase your ebook using USDT on Tron, with the transaction settling in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. Geographic location does not affect functionality.
What if I need to refund a buyer?

Refunds are handled manually via your crypto wallet. The system does not automate refunds because blockchain transactions are irreversible. You retain full control over your funds and can issue refunds directly to the buyer’s wallet address.
Do buyers need a crypto wallet to purchase?

Yes, buyers need a crypto wallet to send payment. However, platforms like Binance P2P allow buyers to purchase crypto using local currency (naira, cedis, shillings, rupees). The buyer then sends the payment to your address via their wallet.
Can I use my own domain with this stack?

Yes. Both the Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack support custom domains. The Edge Stack includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for email delivery. Your domain points to your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages deployment.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments operates as a payment processor, not a platform you depend on. Your stack remains functional because it owns the backend logic and delivery system. You can switch to another processor or self-host payment verification if needed.
You own the deployed system. No platform can suspend your account or change the rules.
